updates.content:
Title: We’ve detected an issue with Azure subscription required for Microsoft Purview inline data protections

User impact: If action isn't taken, DLP policies targeting user data uploads to unmanaged apps in Edge might not function as expected

Current status: We’ve identified through health check activities that a required configuration to activate Purview collection and Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policies in the Edge for Business browser might be missing in your tenant.   
  
The required Azure subscription to activate Purview collection and DLP policies in the Edge for Business browser may be missing in your tenant. For more information on this feature, review the message center post MC1154787.    
  
Please review the recommendations provided to prevent any service interruptions.  



Expiration message: This communication will expire in 14 days, and is scheduled to remain active for the full duration.
